beats.narration_text: Ciao — this is Liam, in for Komal, for Madison's weekly update. Team Madison has three tracks this week. A new direction: detecting inauthentic engagement for Intelligence Agents. Planning CatBot and DogBot, plus LoonNet outreach. And Gavia's last feature — invasive vegetation — expected this week, demo next week.

beats.narration_text: Here is the whole idea. Exploring datasets is not a model in production. Reviewing a proposal is not a bot shipped. Expected to deploy is not deployed. Those distinctions are the week.

beats.narration_text: First receipt: the new project direction. Detecting inauthentic social engagement — bots, fake followers — as a capability for Madison's Intelligence Agents layer. They started exploring datasets and baseline approaches. They discussed it with Nina on Tuesday. Exploring is not a detector shipped.

beats.narration_text: Next: CatBot and DogBot. They are reviewing the project proposal and planning — requirements, key features, an initial development approach, and next steps. A proposal is not a product.
